title: A subset nowhere dense in an open subspace is nowhere dense in the whole space
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement transfers nowhere density from an open subspace to the ambient space (author lemma at source lines 4238-4244, label lemma-image-nowhere-dense-open). The proof (source lines 4246-4254) is a contraposition computed with closures: an interior point of the closure in the ambient space would restrict to an interior point of the closure inside the open subspace, using that intersecting the closure with the open subspace gives the closure there (proof lines 4247-4253). H2.
